national_posture.statement: The August 14 IMSR placed the United States at National Preparedness Level 5, with 93 uncontained large fires, 152 active incidents, and 29,612 personnel assigned.
national_posture.level_meaning: national resources are fully committed, active geographic areas may need emergency measures, and potential for additional significant fires is high

national_posture.statement: The Aug 14 CIFFC situation report kept Canada at National Preparedness Level 5. It showed 110 full-response fires covering 999,324.7 hectares, 3,293 out-of-control fires covering 139,671.5 hectares, and 4,702 fires covering 4,109,604.3 hectares year to date.
national_posture.level_meaning: national demand is extreme, resources are fully committed, and international resources are being mobilized to sustain operations

incidents.name: Old Trails Fire
incidents.location: West of Spokane near Airway Heights
incidents.controlling_agency: California Interagency Incident Management Team 7 and Washington Department of Natural Resources

evacuation.description: Evacuations and area, road, and trail closures remained in effect around the Spokane fires.

incidents.operational_outlook: The Aug 14 pre-cutoff update reported 3,176 acres and 97% containment; minimal creeping and smoldering continued; patrol and damage assessment remained the focus.

attention.coverage_summary: Coverage focused on the arson investigation, roughly 900 reported structures lost, evacuation impacts, emergency response, and residents beginning to return.
attention.methodology_note: Browser-visible search was capped at 60 unique result links; counts are censored observations and no auditable public-discussion count was available.

incidents.analyst_note: **Cat-modeling interpretation:** The 569 lost structures are an unspecified-occupancy total and must not be converted into dwellings. ([NIFC IMSR](https://www.nifc.gov/nicc/sitreprt.pdf))
critical_alert_reasons: at least 25 newly damaged or destroyed structures
named community under evacuation with structure involvement or imminent threat

incidents.name: Grasshopper Fire
incidents.location: Mt. Hood National Forest near Highway 35
incidents.controlling_agency: U.S. Forest Service, Mt. Hood National Forest

evacuation.description: Incident information directs residents to current county evacuation levels and notes a forest closure order.

incidents.operational_outlook: The Aug 14 pre-cutoff update reported 85,114 acres and 20% containment; active running, flanking, and wind-driven behavior continued with residences and critical infrastructure threatened.

attention.coverage_summary: Coverage emphasized continued growth, wind-driven behavior, community and evacuation concerns, and structure protection.
attention.methodology_note: Result count is a browser-visible, title-attributed sample; no auditable public-discussion count was available.

incidents.analyst_note: **Cat-modeling interpretation:** Official sources report qualitative structural and infrastructure threat, not a numeric structure-loss count. ([InciWeb](https://inciweb.wildfire.gov/incident-information/ormhf-grasshopper))
critical_alert_reasons: named community under evacuation with structure involvement or imminent threat

incidents.name: Widemouth 2 Fire
incidents.location: Fishlake National Forest between Kanosh, Meadow, and Fillmore
incidents.controlling_agency: Great Basin Complex Incident Management Team 2 and Fishlake National Forest

evacuation.description: The IMSR reported evacuations, road and area closures; the incident page directs residents to local evacuation information.

incidents.operational_outlook: The Aug 14 pre-cutoff update reported 129,574 acres and 65% containment; monsoonal moisture moderated some activity but dry fuels, patrol, and spotting concerns remained.

attention.coverage_summary: Coverage focused on continued fire growth, improved containment, monsoonal weather, and firefighting operations.
attention.methodology_note: News-area estimates do not replace the official IMSR acreage in the operational record.

incidents.analyst_note: **Source reconciliation:** The Aug 11 NIFC and InciWeb records differ slightly on Widemouth acreage and agree on the current 30% containment; this record uses the controlling incident page value of 122,759 acres. ([NIFC IMSR](https://www.nifc.gov/nicc/sitreprt.pdf))
critical_alert_reasons: named community under evacuation with structure involvement or imminent threat

incidents.name: Bradley Creek Fire
incidents.location: Okanagan Indian Band reserve near Vernon

evacuation.description: Evacuation orders and alerts remained mapped around the Okanagan Indian Band and neighboring jurisdictions.

incidents.operational_outlook: BC Wildfire Service last updated Bradley Creek FSR Aug 13 at 10:21 AM EDT as Being Held at 2,650.3 hectares with two orders and two alerts.

attention.coverage_summary: Coverage centered on residents returning, partial evacuation-order changes, recovery, and readiness for unsettled weather.
attention.methodology_note: No auditable public-discussion count was available.

incidents.analyst_note: **Cat-modeling interpretation:** The roughly 230-home estimate is preliminary and is not a completed parcel-level assessment. ([Associated Press](https://apnews.com/article/wildfire-canada-homes-destroyed-british-columbia-fbbb7f027adb04a9c9b47a109de74082))
critical_alert_reasons: at least 25 newly damaged or destroyed structures
named community under evacuation with structure involvement or imminent threat

incidents.name: Pear Lake Fire
incidents.location: Thompson-Nicola Regional District and Village of Clinton

evacuation.description: Evacuation orders and alerts remained mapped across regional districts, First Nations, and the Village of Clinton.

incidents.operational_outlook: BC Wildfire Service last updated Pear Lake Aug 13 at 2:55 PM EDT as Out of Control at 157,448.4 hectares with eight orders and seven alerts.

attention.coverage_summary: Coverage focused on progress, evacuation-alert reductions for properties, and the potential for continued active behavior and growth.
attention.methodology_note: No auditable public-discussion count was available.

incidents.analyst_note: **Cat-modeling interpretation:** Do not equate about 120 affected properties with destroyed dwellings; reported impacts include non-residential structures and assessment remained incomplete. ([CTV News](https://www.ctvnews.ca/vancouver/article/more-than-100-structures-lost-in-bcs-pear-lake-wildfire-officials-say/))
critical_alert_reasons: named community under evacuation with structure involvement or imminent threat

incidents.name: Rowe Creek Complex
incidents.location: South of Fossil across central Oregon counties
incidents.controlling_agency: Southwest Complex Incident Management Team 2 and Bureau of Land Management

evacuation.description: Incident information retained evacuation, area, road, and trail closure notices.

incidents.operational_outlook: The Aug 14 pre-cutoff update reported 373,777 acres and 81% containment; moderate flanking, backing, and torching continued; command transfer was scheduled and Highway 26/structure work remained operational priorities.

attention.coverage_summary: Coverage focused on active spread, command transition, Highway 26 impacts, firefighter operations, and structure preparation near communities.
attention.methodology_note: No auditable public-discussion count was available.

incidents.analyst_note: **Cat-modeling interpretation:** The 25-loss total is not classified by occupancy. ([NIFC IMSR](https://www.nifc.gov/nicc/sitreprt.pdf))
critical_alert_reasons: named community under evacuation with structure involvement or imminent threat

incidents.name: Aspen Acres Fire
incidents.controlling_agency: Rocky Mountain Complex Incident Management Team 3

evacuation.description: Area and road closures remained in effect; the reviewed update did not quantify active evacuations.

incidents.operational_outlook: The Aug 14 pre-cutoff update reported 102,004 acres and 72% containment; minimal behavior with backing and creeping continued under changing weather and closure management.

attention.coverage_summary: Coverage emphasized continued containment, recovery and closure conditions, and minimal fire behavior under wetter weather.
attention.methodology_note: No auditable public-discussion count was available.

incidents.analyst_note: **Cat-modeling interpretation:** The 915 lost structures are cumulative and unspecified by occupancy. ([NIFC IMSR](https://www.nifc.gov/nicc/sitreprt.pdf))

incidents.name: Kaiser Canyon Fire
incidents.controlling_agency: Bureau of Indian Affairs and Alaska Incident Management Team 2

evacuation.description: Evacuations and road closures remained in effect near the incident.

incidents.operational_outlook: The Aug 14 pre-cutoff update reported 138,272 acres and 81% containment; active behavior and structure protection continued during transfer of command and ongoing evacuation and closure measures.

attention.coverage_summary: Coverage remained limited and local, focusing on containment gains, command transition, structure protection, and resources.
attention.methodology_note: No auditable public-discussion count was available.

incidents.analyst_note: **Cat-modeling interpretation:** The 47 losses are cumulative and unspecified by occupancy. ([NIFC IMSR](https://www.nifc.gov/nicc/sitreprt.pdf))
critical_alert_reasons: named community under evacuation with structure involvement or imminent threat

global_overview.statement: The reviewed international headline sample continued to focus on Serbia and the wider Balkan/European wildfire season, including Deliblato Sands aftermath and ongoing impacts in Greece, France, and Spain. This is a headline scan, not comprehensive worldwide operational intelligence.
